C1107.title: South Korean High School Student Arrested for Creating and Selling Deepfake Pornography
C1107.summary: In July 2024, South Korean police arrested a high school student in North Gyeongsang Province for allegedly using deepfake technology to create sexually explicit images and sell them via Telegram. On June 7, the suspect posted on social media offering to produce deepfake pornographic images based on buyers' family members, acquaintances, or celebrities, at 1,000-2,000 won per image, completing about 10 transactions and earning over 300,000 won. Police seized 317 materials; most victims were middle school acquaintances. Yonhap reported the case on September 5, a typical case of deepfake sexual crime trending younger.
